_comment: Manual corrections applied after Wikipedia parsing; they beat every other source. Each rule needs a reason and a source (a URL or a dated note). 'until' dates (yyyy-mm-dd) make a rule lapse by itself. See docs/PLAN.md 'Conflict resolution'.
